zh.title: Archer與AEG合作 於洛杉磯市中心籌設垂直起降機場
zh.summary: Archer夥AEG於洛杉磯L.A. LIVE籌設電動飛載垂直起降場
body: 美國電動垂直起降飛行器（eVTOL）開發商Archer Aviation與體育娛樂集團AEG於2026年8月24日宣布達成協議，將在洛杉磯市中心的L.A. LIVE娛樂區開發一座垂直起降機場（Vertiport）。根據雙方簽署的獨家合作協議，Archer將成為該娛樂園區的獨家空中計程車合作夥伴。
兩家公司表示已完成針對土地使用、空域環境、電力供應及社區影響的初步可行性評估，目前正開展第二階段研究，以評估營運模式與乘客體驗。然而，雙方尚未公布相關財務條款、建設時間表或預計啟用日期，亦未透露目前是否已取得任何洛杉磯市政府或美國聯邦航空局（FAA）的法規審批或許可。
該座計畫中的市中心站點擬採用BETA Technologies開發的充電設備，該設備屬於Archer、BETA與Macquarie Capital於2026年7月16日聯合成立的「美國電動空域聯盟」（ACES）推動項目。此外，Archer與AEG安排於2026年8月24日至25日在L.A. LIVE展示採用「美國隊」（Team USA）塗裝的Midnight飛行器。

這座位於L.A. LIVE的站點擬納入Archer在洛杉磯地區規劃的空中計程車網路。該網路預計以霍桑市立機場（HHR）作為營運樞紐，並連接洛杉磯國際機場（LAX）、好萊塢伯班克機場（BUR）、SoFi球場及南加州大學等重要地點。不過，Archer旗下主要的Midnight飛行器目前尚未取得FAA的型別認證。在2026年8月10日公布的第二季財報中，Archer報告淨虧損2.632億美元，同時持有15.6億美元的現金及短期投資，並預計在2026年稍後於eVTOL整合試點計畫下展開Midnight營運測試。

en.title: Archer Aviation and AEG Partner to Develop Vertiport at L.A. LIVE in Downtown Los Angeles
en.summary: Archer Aviation and AEG announced plans to develop a downtown Los Angeles vertiport at L.A. LIVE.
body: Electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft developer Archer Aviation and sports and entertainment group AEG announced an agreement on August 24, 2026, to develop a vertiport at L.A. LIVE in downtown Los Angeles. Under the terms of the exclusive partnership, Archer will serve as the exclusive air taxi partner for the four-million-square-foot entertainment district.

The project partners have completed an initial feasibility study covering key parameters such as land use, airspace management, power availability, and community impact. A second phase examining operational procedures and guest experience is currently underway. However, neither company disclosed financial terms, a construction timeline, or a target entry-into-service date, and no municipal or Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) approvals have been secured to date.

Infrastructure plans for the proposed site include charging hardware supplied by BETA Technologies under America’s Consortium for Electric Skyways (ACES), an initiative launched on July 16, 2026, by Archer, BETA, and Macquarie Capital. Additionally, Archer and AEG plan to display a Midnight aircraft featuring a 'Team USA' livery at L.A. LIVE from the morning of August 24 through August 25, 2026.

The planned L.A. LIVE facility is intended to join Archer's broader network across Los Angeles, which envisions Hawthorne Municipal Airport (HHR) as its central operational hub while connecting key regional locations including Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), Hollywood Burbank Airport (BUR), SoFi Stadium, and the University of Southern California. However, Archer's Midnight aircraft does not yet hold FAA type certification. In its second-quarter 2026 financial report published on August 10, Archer reported a net loss of $263.2 million and $1.56 billion in cash, cash equivalents, and short-term investments, noting that it expects to begin Midnight test operations later in 2026 under the FAA's eVTOL Integration Pilot Program.

zh.title: 保加利亞查獲強烈GPS干擾器 索菲亞機場（SOF）與過境航班受影響
zh.summary: 保加利亞安全局清除干擾索菲亞機場的GPS干擾器；航班改用地面導航；未影響飛安
body: 保加利亞國家安全局（DANS）於2026年8月21日表示，該局與通訊監管委員會（CRC）及索菲亞警政署展開聯合行動，成功定位並消除一部位於首都索菲亞的強烈全球衛星定位系統（GPS）干擾器。該設備持續干擾索菲亞地區的GPS訊號，影響範圍涵蓋索菲亞機場（SOF）的航管與升降作業。
根據保加利亞國家安全局發布的聲明，該干擾裝置係於首都索菲亞德拉加萊夫齊區（Dragalevtsi）一處設有嚴密警衛的建築群內尋獲。調查人員指出，該設備產生的訊號干擾直接影響索菲亞機場使用的GPS頻率、飛越索菲亞上空的過境航班，以及當地的電視廣播塔。官方目前尚未公布該設備的型號、擁有者或操作人員資訊，亦未宣布逮捕任何嫌疑人。
保加利亞交通暨通訊部長格奧爾基·佩耶夫（Georgi Peev）說明，航管部門於2026年8月21日立即偵測到衛星導航訊號異常。雖然衛星導航遭受干擾並對飛行管理造成一定程度影響，但受影響航班隨即切換至保加利亞全國地面傳統導航系統進行應對。佩耶夫強調，整起事件並未對整體飛行安全構成影響。
索菲亞機場新聞辦公室於2026年8月21日向媒體確認，機場各項營運未受干擾器影響，所有航班均保持正常時程起降。民航機師亞歷山大·博戈亞夫倫斯基（Aleksandar Bogoyavlenski）則表示，進出索菲亞的航班在事件前已連續多日出現GPS訊號中斷情形，但得益於機組員即時改用地面傳統導航，未導致任何飛安問題或航班延誤。

en.title: Bulgaria Neutralizes High-Powered GPS Jammer Affecting Sofia Airport (SOF)
en.summary: Bulgaria neutralized a GPS jammer near Sofia Airport ; aircraft switched to ground navaids without flight delays.
body: Bulgaria’s State Agency for National Security (DANS) announced that it located and neutralized a high-powered GPS jamming device in the capital city of Sofia on August 21, 2026. The joint operation was executed alongside the Communications Regulation Commission (CRC) and the Sofia Directorate of the Interior after widespread interference affected satellite navigation frequencies across the metropolitan area, including operations at Sofia Airport (SOF).

According to an official statement issued by DANS, the jamming equipment was discovered within a heavily guarded complex situated in Sofia’s Dragalevtsi district. Authorities confirmed that the device suppressed GPS frequencies utilized by Sofia Airport , aircraft overflying the Bulgarian capital, and local television broadcast towers. The agency did not release details regarding the technical specifications, ownership, or operators of the device, and no arrests were immediately announced.

Bulgarian Transport and Communications Minister Georgi Peev stated on August 21, 2026, that the electronic interference was detected immediately by air traffic controllers. While satellite-based navigation was compromised and impacted flight management procedures, safety standards were maintained. Affected flights transitioned from satellite positioning to Bulgaria’s network of conventional ground-based terrestrial navigation aids to maintain normal course guidance.

The press office of Sofia Airport  confirmed on August 21, 2026, that flight operations remained unaffected and scheduled services operated on time. Commercial pilot Aleksandar Bogoyavlenski noted that arriving and departing flights had experienced GPS signal loss over Sofia for at least three consecutive days prior to the device being neutralized, but emphasized that switching to ground-based navigation prevented flight delays or safety hazards.

zh.title: 空服員工會憂人手不足 阿拉斯加航空波音787-9長途擴展面臨挑戰
zh.summary: 阿拉斯加航空計畫擴展長途航線；空服員工會指波音787-9人手不足
body: 阿拉斯加航空（Alaska Airlines）計畫擴大西雅圖出發的國際長途航線網絡，預計自2027年5月起推出開往雅典與巴黎的季節性直飛服務。其中，雅典航線定於5月12日首航，每週營運三個航班；巴黎航線則預計於5月25日開航，每週提供五個航班。這兩條跨洲航線均將由阿拉斯加航空的波音787-9（Boeing 787-9）廣體客機負責執飛。
然而，代表該公司空服員的美國空服員協會（AFA）對波音787-9機隊的營運人手配置提出疑慮。工會指出，現行機組人員配置數量使得空服員難以達到管理階層所宣傳的機上服務標準，並強調目前的服務模式為工作人員帶來無法持續的工作步調與負擔。
根據工會說明，阿拉斯加航空管理階層在4月啟動波音787國際航班時，曾實施為期30天的觀察期以收集反饋並改進服務細節。然而該觀察期於5月28日結束後，管理階層並未採取工會要求的調整措施。工會因此要求航空公司應增加機艙組員配置，或與空服員協商制定符合現有人力資源的服務規範。
阿拉斯加航空規劃在未來數年內，將自西雅圖出發的國際長途航線增加至12條以上，並計畫於2030年前再增設至少5個跨洲航點。本站歷史紀錄顯示，該公司已於2026年8月20日開放雅典航線（航班號AS196）與巴黎航線（航班號AS136）之機票銷售。

en.title: Flight Attendants Raise Staffing Concerns Over Alaska Airlines Boeing 787-9 Expansion
en.summary: Alaska Airlines faces flight attendant union staffing concerns over Boeing 787-9 long-haul route expansion.
body: Alaska Airlines has announced plans to expand its intercontinental route network from Seattle by introducing seasonal nonstop flights to Athens and Paris starting in May 2027. Under the carrier's announced schedule, the new Athens route will operate three times weekly beginning May 12, while the Paris service will operate five times weekly starting May 25. Both long-haul routes are scheduled to be operated using Alaska Airlines' Boeing 787-9 Dreamliner widebody aircraft.

However, the expansion plans come as the Association of Flight Attendants-CWA (AFA), the labor union representing flight attendants at the airline, raised operational concerns regarding staffing levels on the Boeing 787-9 fleet. The union stated that current cabin crew staffing levels make it impossible to deliver the premium onboard service promised by airline management, emphasizing that the existing service model creates an unsustainable working pace for cabin crew members.

According to the AFA, Alaska Airlines management had previously instituted a 30-day observation period when Alaska-branded Boeing 787 international flights launched in April, with a commitment to gather feedback and make operational improvements. The union stated that this review period concluded on May 28 without management implementing the changes sought by flight attendants. Consequently, the union has called on the airline to either increase cabin crew staffing or establish agreed service standards that realistically reflect available resources.

These new route additions fit into Alaska Airlines' broader strategy to operate more than 12 international long-haul routes out of Seattle in the coming years, with at least five additional intercontinental destinations planned by 2030. According to verified archive records, tickets for the new Seattle-Athens service (operating as flight AS196) and the Seattle-Paris service (operating as flight AS136) officially went on sale on August 20, 2026.
